Returns the stored last‑refresh timestamp, or null if no refresh has
ever been recorded.

name: getProduct
desc:
Returns a Product for the given barcode, either from cache or from
the remote API.

name: isCacheOverdue
desc:
Returns true when the last refresh timestamp is missing or older than
cacheOverdueDays days.

name: moveItemsToInventory
desc: Moves multiple inventory items to a different inventory (pantry).

name: refreshInventoryProducts
desc: Re‑fetches all products referenced by inventory items in inventoryId.

name: refreshInventoryProductsBackground
desc: Fires‑off refreshInventoryProducts without awaiting the result.

name: renameInventory
desc: Renames the inventory with the given id.

name: setLastRefreshTime
desc: Records the current time as the last successful product refresh.

name: productRepositoryProvider
desc: Provides the single ProductRepository instance used throughout the app.

name: ProductSubmissionService
desc: Coordinates the submission of a manually entered product to Open Food Facts.

name: submitProduct
desc: Submits product to Open Food Facts along with any local images.

name: ScannerOverlayPainter
desc:
Paints a semi‑transparent dark overlay with a rounded‑rectangle cutout
and an animated horizontal scanning line inside the cutout.

name: animationValue
desc:
Value between 0.0 and 1.0 that controls the vertical position of the
scanning line inside the cutout.

name: hintText
desc: The localised hint text shown below the cutout.

name: paint
desc:
Called whenever the object needs to paint. The given Canvas has its
coordinate space configured such that the origin is at the top left of the
box. The area of the box is the size of the size argument.

name: shouldRepaint
desc:
Called whenever a new instance of the custom painter delegate class is
provided to the RenderCustomPaint object, or any time that a new
CustomPaint object is created with a new instance of the custom painter
delegate class (which amounts to the same thing, because the latter is
implemented in terms of the former).

name: ScannerErrorContent
desc: Displays scanner error content based on the error code.

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.

name: exception
desc: The exception that caused the scanner error.

name: onOpenSettings
desc: Called when the user wants to open app settings.

name: onRetry
desc: Called when the user taps the retry button.

name: onSwitchToManual
desc: Called when the user switches to manual barcode entry.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: SearchScreen
desc:
A search‑focused tab that lets the user find products by name or
barcode, querying both the local cache and the Open Food Facts API.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: Settings
desc: Persistent settings for the pantry app.

name: Settings.new
desc: Creates a Settings instance with the given values.

name: amoledDarkMode
desc: Whether pure-black surfaces should be used in dark mode.

name: copyWith
desc: Returns a copy with the given fields replaced.

name: expiringSoonDays
desc: Number of days within which an item is considered "expiring soon".

name: inactivityReminderEnabled
desc: Whether the inactivity reminder is enabled.

name: inactivityThresholdDays
desc: Number of days of inactivity before a reminder is sent.

name: retentionDays
desc: Number of days before an old inventory item is automatically cleaned up.

name: SettingsNotifier
desc:
A Notifier that holds the current Settings and persists every field
to SharedPreferences.

name: SettingsScreen
desc: A screen where the user can adjust application preferences.

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.

name: SnackbarHelper
desc: A thin wrapper around ScaffoldMessenger that shows styled snackbars.

name: showUndo
desc: Shows an info snackbar with an undo action.

name: parentCategory
desc: Returns a broad parent category from OFF hierarchy data.

name: statsProvider
desc: Aggregated statistics for the active pantry inventory.

name: StatsScreen
desc: Displays aggregated statistics for the active pantry.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: equalsIgnoreCaseAndDiacritics
desc: Compares a and b ignoring case and diacritics.

name: removeDiacritics
desc: Removes common Latin diacritics from input and lowercases the result.

name: ThemeModeNotifier
desc:
A Notifier that holds the current ThemeModeOption and persists it to
SharedPreferences under the theme_mode key.

name: ThemeModeOption
desc: The available theme modes for the app.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: showWhatsNewSheet
desc: Shows a bottom sheet listing changelog entries since the last seen version.
